answer: 0.25 marks in Paper-I and 1 mark in Paper-II

options: No negative marking in either paper

1 mark in Paper-I and 0.25 marks in Paper-II
question: According to the SSC Junior Engineer Examination 2026 notice, what is the negative marking in Paper-I and Paper-II?
solution: The notice (para 13.10) states a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I and one (01) mark for each wrong answer in Paper-II. Source checked: https://ssc.gov.in/api/attachment/uploads/masterData/NoticeBoards/Notice_of_adv_je_2026.pdf
